architecture: shore power -> marine enclosure -> ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi logger -> electrically isolated DO and conductivity interfaces + temperature/depth -> local flash/SD buffer -> authenticated Jubilee ingest endpoint

sensor_strategy.dissolved_oxygen: Atlas Scientific galvanic DO/EZO-class candidate; zero-oxygen plus air-saturation calibration required because <1 mg/L performance matters
sensor_strategy.salinity: conductivity/EZO-class candidate with electrical isolation from DO
sensor_strategy.temperature: waterproof digital or calibrated analog temperature sensor colocated with probes
sensor_strategy.depth: low-cost pressure/depth sensor preferred; if deferred, pair fixed sensor elevation with trusted local water-level source

telemetry.wifi: existing pier network; credentials must be provisioned locally and never committed to repository

mounting: near bottom at pier end, approximately 0.15-0.30 m above sediment where practical; quick-retrieval service mount; avoid piling stagnant microenvironment and prop wash
budget_rule: Do not finalize purchase until current vendor pricing shows sensors, isolation, controller, storage, enclosure, power conditioning, cables and mount below $1,000 delivered.
model_rule: DIRECT only for the 437/Montrose local sensor location; production weight remains zero until QC and held-out incremental value are demonstrated.
